mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating demand, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth decelerates below 2% annualized in the subsequent 3 months, or if S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as profit margins compress.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rebounds above its 6-month moving average within 1 month, or if S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening cycle that raises discount rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% for an additional 2 months, or if S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 6.5% within 1 month, or if S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating residential construction activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as related sectors outperform.
failure_condition: If HOUST declines below its 12-month moving average within 1 month, or if S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the real sales of domestic product (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening economic activity, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings prospects deteriorate.
failure_condition: If RSAFS rebounds above its 12-month moving average within 1 month, or if S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% signals accelerating inflation, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings and Fed policy adjustments.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL remains below 3% for an additional 2 months, or if S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals accelerating labor market strength, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations improve.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS growth decelerates below 2% annualized in the subsequent 3 months, or if S&P 500 returns over the 20-day horizon are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods.
